component.name: Recordly
component.summary: 开源屏幕录制与回放工具

description.p: 一款开源的屏幕录制和回放工具，支持鼠标轨迹记录、 多轨道时间线编辑、各种光标特效和多种导出格式（MP4/GIF/APNG）。 基于 Python + PyQt5 构建，轻量高效。
Refactor: modularize MainWindow into Mixin controllers; resolve recording race condition, add deep schema validation, fix thumbnail resolution, and eliminate private cross-module coupling.
Feature: inline mini volume slider on audio clips + Inspector panel with continuous 0-200% volume control.
Bug fix: AUR package — bundle pynput._xorg module (Xvfb in AUR build env).
